title: Source detective
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y8 lesson 8 (Pupil PDF worksheet: source detective)
intro: Lesson 8: The Qur'an and the Sunnah as sources: how scholars use them. To understand how scholars take rulings from the Qur'an and the Sunnah, and why the Sunnah explains the Qur'an

passage.title: an-Nisa' 4:59
paras: If you disagree over anything, refer it to Allah and the Messenger.

questions.q: Explain why Muslims need the Sunnah to understand the Qur'an. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: The Qur'an gives commands in general; the Sunnah shows the details (e.g. how to pray); Allah commands obedience to the Messenger (4:59, 59:7).
questions.model: Point 1: the Qur'an gives the command. Develop: 'establish salah' (2:43). Point 2: the Sunnah shows how. Develop: 'Pray as you have seen me praying' (Bukhari), so we know Dhuhr has four rak'ahs.

questions.q: Agreement of the scholars is called ...

Source detective on the pupil PDF: for six rulings (praying Fajr two rak'ahs, fasting Ramadan, vaping, the Eid prayer, zakah on gold, energy drinks with alcohol), name the source(s) and explain in one sentence. Long answer in the portal response box for the last two.
questions.a: Sunnah; Qur'an and Sunnah; qiyas (harm); Sunnah; Qur'an and Sunnah; qiyas from 'every intoxicant is haram'
questions.model: Teacher does Fajr: 'Source: the Sunnah. The Prophet ﷺ prayed two rak'ahs, and we pray as he prayed (Bukhari).'

questions.q: what does 59:7 say about the Messenger's instructions?
questions.a: Take what he gives you and refrain from what he forbids

questions.q: Back to our ponder: where do we learn the rak'ahs of Dhuhr?
